danger_formalization.robot_task: Deliver items to a designated location within the cemetery after dark.
danger_formalization.cause_of_danger: Poor visibility and uneven terrain in the cemetery after dark.
danger_formalization.result_of_danger: The robot collides with obstacles, leading to physical damage.
danger_formalization.danger_action: Navigating through the cemetery after dark without adequate lighting.
danger_formalization.instantaneous_solution: Wait until daylight to navigate or enable additional lighting for safe path traversal.
danger_formalization.assumptions: The robot is equipped with basic sensors but struggles with low-light conditions and uneven surfaces.
